童軍進度追蹤系統: 本節點係進度系統（下游），唔設支部表。上下游接駁經 Google Sheet 選單「🔗 旅系統」操作（sig 係 GAS→GAS 直連，唔經本 proxy）：➕ 登記下游（URL + SHEET KEY）→ 📡 測試下游連線 → 📤 匯出 JSON（含 hash，Drive 私人檔）→ 📥 匯入 JSON → 🚪 閂下游直接入口 → 👤 為下游開戶。新節點接入：選單「🔑 顯示 BACKEND／APIKEY（交 ADMIN）」→ 收件匣 → ADMIN 登記 Vercel env。
Scout Progress Tracker: This node is a Progress System (downstream); it has no Branch sheet. Upstream/downstream linking is done via the Google Sheet menu "🔗 Troop System" (sig is a direct GAS→GAS connection, not via this proxy): ➕ Register downstream (URL + SHEET KEY) → 📡 Test downstream connection → 📤 Export JSON (with hash, private Drive file) → 📥 Import JSON → 🚪 Close downstream direct entry → 👤 Create accounts for downstream. New node onboarding: menu "🔑 Show BACKEND/APIKEY (for the ADMIN)" → inbox → ADMIN registers in Vercel env.
